text: Nate won his first video game tournament in the week of 10 January 2022 and called the win very exciting.
Nate's first tournament win came in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, a team shooter game, and Nate said Nate and the team had a blast right to the very end.
Joanna said on 21 January 2022 that a project she had been working on lately was pretty cool, and asked Nate about any fun projects or hobbies he had.
Joanna said she is not really into video games herself, but she agreed the tournament win sounded like a fun experience for Nate.
Joanna listed her hobbies as writing, reading, watching movies and exploring nature, and asked Nate whether he enjoys anything else.
Nate said his main hobbies are playing video games and watching movies, and noted that he and Joanna have similar interests.
Nate said he loves action and sci-fi movies because the effects are so cool, and asked Joanna what her favourite genre was.
Joanna said she is all about dramas and romantic comedies because she loves getting immersed in the feelings and plots of a film.
On 21 January 2022 Joanna recommended a romantic drama about memory and relationships to Nate and shared a photo of its poster, which shows a man and a woman sitting on a bench.
Joanna said she first watched that romantic drama around 2019, about three years before January 2022, and went out to buy a physical DVD copy of it.
Joanna said she has seen the romantic drama a few times, that it is one of her favourites, and that she really likes both its idea and its acting.
Nate said he might check out the romantic drama soon because he loves watching classics, and thanked Joanna for the recommendation.
Joanna asked Nate to let her know if he likes the romantic drama, and Nate said he would definitely check it out.
Joanna opened the 23 January 2022 conversation by saying she had not talked to Nate in a few days and that crazy things had happened to her.
Joanna finished her first full screenplay and printed it on Friday 21 January 2022, and said it was a relief to have the long project finished.
Joanna described her first screenplay as a mix of drama and romance, and shared a photo of a printed page of text with the 23 January 2022 message.

Joanna described feeling a rollercoaster of relief, excitement and some anxiety about finishing the screenplay, and said she planned to submit it to film festivals in the hope that producers and directors would see it.
Nate shared a photo of a turtle and a turtleling on a rock and said he has had them for 3 years as of 23 January 2022, and that they bring him tons of joy.
Joanna said Nate's turtles look adorable and asked how long Nate has had them.
Nate said his small turtles have big personalities and help him stay calm when things are important and he is nervous, so he recommended small animals like them for times of stress.
Joanna said on 23 January 2022 that she might get pets of her own soon if she could find any she is not allergic to.
Nate said he had started hanging out with people outside his usual circle at the tournament and found them pretty cool.

Joanna asked whether it was a weird relationship for Nate to be friends with competitors, and Nate said it is kind of weird because some competitors are more competitive than others, so he sticks with the chiller people.
Nate said he does not expect to win big at the tournament, he simply likes playing for fun, and he would cheer on competitors even if he lost.
Joanna said she is allergic to pets: her face gets puffy and itchy around certain animals, and she is allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur.
Nate said he was glad Joanna has other things, such as writing and hanging out with friends, to help her through times of anxiety even though she cannot have animals.
Joanna said writing and hanging out with friends bring her joy, and that writing helps her create wild worlds with awesome characters and express her feelings.
Nate encouraged Joanna to keep doing what she loves, and Joanna said she would keep pursuing her passion for writing.
Joanna said on 7 February 2022 that the screenplay she sent to a film festival had been on her mind all day, every day, and that she kept swinging between relief, excitement and worry.
Nate said submitting a screenplay to a film festival is a big deal, and he hoped a producer or director would like it enough to get it on the big screen.
Nate said on 7 February 2022 that not much had changed for him, but he had just discovered he can make coconut milk ice cream and that it turned out pretty good.
Nate said his coconut milk ice cream was rich and creamy and might become his new favourite snack, and said he would try it again with different flavours and toppings.
Joanna said Nate's ice cream looked delicious and that she loved it when Nate tried something new and it worked out, and asked whether Nate would make it again.
When Joanna asked for his favourite dairy-free dessert flavours, Nate said he loves coconut milk and also enjoys chocolate and mixed berry flavours.
Nate said the other day, before 7 February 2022, he made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on it and thought Joanna might like it.
Joanna said she was tempted to try dairy-free flavours after seeing Nate's photo of a cake with berries, and shared her own photo of a piece of cake with berries on a plate.
Joanna said she should make a dairy-free cake herself or pay Nate a visit to try one, and praised Nate's cooking skills.
Nate said he has not seen any good movies recently and asked Joanna for recommendations.
Joanna recommended the film Little Women to Nate on 7 February 2022, describing it as a great story about sisterhood, love and reaching for your dreams, and said it was a must-see.
Nate said he would add Little Women to his watch list and that Joanna would be the first to hear what he thought of it.
Joanna said she is always happy to give movie recommendations and asked Nate to let her know what he thinks of Little Women when he has finished it.
Nate said he would ask Joanna for movie recommendations whenever he runs out of things to watch.
On 25 February 2022 Nate said he made ice cream for a friend who loved it, and that the flavour he made was chocolate and vanilla swirl.
Joanna said on 25 February 2022 that she cannot have dairy, so she cannot eat ice cream, and asked Nate for a dairy-free recipe to try.
Nate offered to send Joanna a dairy-free recipe that uses coconut milk, and Joanna said she was keen to try it and always up for something sweet.
Nate said he would send the recipe and wanted to hear what Joanna thought of it, and Joanna said she would keep Nate posted on how it turned out.
Joanna said Nate's cooking is amazing and that she cannot stop thinking about her first screenplay, so she started writing a second one while she waited to hear back about the first.
Nate said taking your mind off something like waiting for news is very challenging, and asked Joanna what her new screenplay was about.
Joanna described her second screenplay as being about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss, who takes a road trip to heal and grow.
Joanna said the second screenplay is her own story, inspired by personal experiences and her own journey of self-discovery, and that it deals with loss and figuring out who you are.
Nate said he was pumped to see how Joanna's first screenplay does, and Joanna said she hoped it would get noticed and make it to the screen.
Nate said he was crossing his fingers that Joanna's screenplay would find a fan, and wished her good luck with it.
Joanna said on 18 March 2022 that she had wrapped up her second script and that the feelings were wild, with relief at times and anxiety about what comes next at others.
Joanna described her mix of feelings about her second script as excitement and terror about her work getting noticed and hitting the big screen.
Joanna said she has been decompressing since finishing her second script but finds it hard to switch off, describing a constant tug-of-war between hope and doubt.
Nate told Joanna on 18 March 2022 that doubts are normal, that her hard work and passion would shine through and get her script noticed, and that she should believe in herself.
Nate shared a photo of two tortoises lying on the ground in a jungle and said walking them always reminds him to enjoy the small stuff.
Nate said he is drawn to turtles because they are unique, their slow pace is a nice change from the rush of life, and they are low-maintenance and calming.
Nate said caring for turtles is not hard: keep their area clean, feed them properly and make sure they get enough light, and that it is actually kind of fun.
Joanna said on 18 March 2022 that she wishes she was not allergic to pets and would get two turtles that day if she could.
Joanna said she recently found out she is allergic to cockroaches as well, so she is not sure she will ever get a pet.
Nate promised Joanna he would send pictures of his turtles so she could watch them grow without getting too close to them.
Joanna said she has been doing research and networking non-stop for her script, and is determined to make it happen even though it is tough.
Nate told Joanna not to quit because the path forward would show up soon, and Joanna said having someone to support her through the whole process gives her the motivation to keep pushing forward.
Joanna ended the 18 March 2022 conversation by saying she would talk to Nate later and shared a photo of a cinema ticket on a chair.
Joanna said on 24 March 2022 that she had an audition for a writing gig the day before, on 23 March 2022, which went alright and left her with mixed emotions.
Nate said on 24 March 2022 that he is currently taking part in the video game tournament again, and that it is intense with a lot of adrenaline flowing.
Joanna said her go-to place for writing inspiration is a bookshelf full of books and magazines, which helps her stay sharp and motivated, and she shared a photo of it.
Joanna advised Nate that a writer should read lots, try out different genres, build a solid understanding of literature, and not be afraid to write and share, even if it is just with friends.
Joanna also advised Nate to keep practising and gather feedback to get better, and to have faith in himself and keep following his writing dreams even though it is tough but worth it.
Nate said he would keep working hard on his writing and see what happens, and wished Joanna good luck with her project, which he was sure would turn out great.
Joanna said she would keep Nate updated on her audition and her project, and asked Nate for news on his end.
Nate said on 15 April 2022 that he dyed his hair in the week of 4 April 2022 and was stoked about the new colour.
On 15 April 2022 Joanna said that dyeing hair must feel liberating and asked Nate how he was feeling, after which Nate shared a selfie of himself with purple hair and glasses.
Nate chose the purple hair colour because it is bright and bold, like Nate, and because he wanted to stand out from the regular options.

Joanna said Nate's boldness really inspired her, and that it reminded her of a gorgeous sunset she saw while hiking the other day, which made her realise the importance of showing the world who we are.
Joanna shared a photo of a street with a stop sign and a cloudy sky alongside her story about the sunset she saw while hiking the other day.
Joanna said on 15 April 2022 that she wished she had a vacation lined up, but her writing was consuming her and she was hoping for good news soon.
Nate said he was jealous of Joanna's sunset and asked whether she had any more exciting trips coming up, and asked her to keep him posted on how things go.
Joanna said Nate's support means a lot and that she would keep Nate updated, and the two agreed to see each other soon.
Joanna said on 17 April 2022 that she had been reading a lot in the week before, rediscovering several good books she had forgotten she owned.
Joanna said she found an awesome hiking trail in her hometown on 16 April 2022, which she found gorgeous, and asked Nate whether he knew any good hiking spots.
Nate said he is not really into hiking but is curious about the trail, and that he had heard there is a nice trail just north of where he lives.
Joanna said she hoped to convince Nate to go hiking with her one day, and Nate said he likes nature and it might be fun going with someone else.
Joanna said she is a huge fan of nature, which is why she goes hiking, and Nate agreed that nature has a way of being so inspiring.
Joanna said nature has always been her haven, and that walking in it and hearing its sounds makes worries and stress seem to vanish.
Nate said spending time with his pets and engaging in his hobbies gives him peace, because they let him take a break from reality.
Nate shared a photo of a turtle and a strawberry in a bowl, and Joanna said she loves Nate's turtles so much and finds them so cute.
Nate said he sometimes brings his turtles into the kitchen so they can watch him make food, and shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream and a bowl of sprinkles.
Joanna said she loves Nate's ice cream and wished she could make it the way Nate does, and Nate said it is dairy-free and easy and offered her the recipe.
Nate said his dairy-free ice cream is made with coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar and a pinch of salt, and that the mixture is chilled in the fridge before going into the ice cream maker.
Nate said the ice cream is frozen in the ice cream maker until it is scoopable, and Joanna said she is lactose intolerant so she needed the dairy-free version.
Joanna said on 17 April 2022 that she planned to try making Nate's ice cream that night and promised to let Nate know how it turns out.
Joanna said on 21 April 2022 that she had just joined a writers group, where the inspiring people really got her writing, and that she finally felt she belonged somewhere.
Joanna said she is working with her writers group on a script called Finding Home, about a girl on a journey to find her true home, which she finds rewarding and emotional.
Nate said he has a gaming tournament next month, in May 2022, which will be his 4th tournament, and that he is feeling good about it.
Joanna said that at her first stage play she was so nervous that she forgot her lines, which taught her how important it is to prepare and stay in the moment.
Joanna confirmed that she is the person in the photo of a man in a striped suit performing on stage, and said acting was her first passion, though writing now shines brighter for her.
Joanna said she might go back to acting someday but is going to keep writing, and that she really enjoys dramas and emotionally driven films.
Nate said he loves fantasy and sci-fi movies because they are a great escape that get his imagination going, and that playing video games is a way to express his creativity and passion.
Nate said one fantasy or sci-fi trilogy is among his favourites, praising its world building, battles and storytelling, and shared a photo of a shelf full of books.
Nate recommended a book series with adventures, magic and great characters to Joanna on 21 April 2022, calling it a must-read, and shared a photo of a bunch of books on a table.
Joanna said she had heard of the book series Nate recommended, that it had been on her list forever, and that she was definitely going to check it out.
Joanna said she is always up for new book recommendations and asked Nate what books he enjoys.
Joanna said on 2 May 2022 that she had watched the Lord of the Rings trilogy the night before, on 1 May 2022, after taking Nate's recommendation, and that it was awesome.
Nate said The Lord of the Rings is probably the greatest trilogy of all time, and shared a photo of his gaming room with a computer and a gaming chair.
Nate said he had been focusing on gaming, practising a lot and winning a few tournaments, and that he won his second tournament in the week of 25 April 2022.
Nate said he usually plays CS:GO but tried the local Street Fighter tournament this time, since he plays Street Fighter a lot with his friends, and he won it.
Nate said the other finalist in the Street Fighter tournament shook his hand after the final match, which had a lot of adrenaline.
Joanna said she had been testing dairy-free dessert recipes for friends and family while working on her screenplay, and shared a photo of a cake she had made recently.
Joanna described her recent cake as dairy-free vanilla with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting, and said she really liked the coconut recommendation Nate gave her a while back.
Joanna said cooking and baking are her creative outlets, and that making dairy-free desserts as delicious as regular ones is a rewarding challenge.
Joanna said on 2 May 2022 that she would keep trying new things, and Nate said it must be so rewarding to see everyone enjoying her creations.
Joanna said that between 2 and 12 May 2022 she went hiking and found more amazing trails in her town, and she thinks she is now an expert hiker.
Nate asked Joanna whether she took any photos on the hike, and Joanna said yes, including one at a spot where the rush of the water was so soothing.
Joanna shared a photo of a waterfall with a dark sky in the background, taken at a location she named Whispering Falls.
Nate said he loved the dark sky and green scenery in Joanna's Whispering Falls photo and wished he could have been there, saying her hikes sound like a blast.
Joanna said Whispering Falls was really peaceful and serene, and that the sound of the place and the beauty of nature made her calm and let everything else fade away.
Joanna said hiking has opened up a whole new world for her, that nature totally inspires her, and that she feels like a different person now.
Nate said it is great to have something that gets Joanna's creative juices flowing, after she described how the hikes inspire her.
Joanna said she always feels she could write a whole movie when she is out in cool places, and that the trails made her feel like writing a drama.
Nate said that when he gets deep in thought outdoors he thinks about his life or new recipes, and Joanna said she also thinks about her life when she is out and about.
Nate said nature can be a break from the craziness and that he was glad Joanna found a spot that calms her down.
Nate suggested that he and Joanna should go hiking together sometime and said he might start thinking of a drama himself and publish his own screenplay.
Joanna invited Nate to come down and join her on the trails sometime, and Nate accepted, saying it sounded like a plan.
Nate introduced his newly adopted dog, Max, in the 20 May 2022 conversation, sharing a photo of Max lying on a couch in a living room.
Nate said Max is so full of energy that Max is keeping Nate's other pets active too, and that Max is filling Nate's life with joy.
Joanna said Max is adorable, asked how long Nate had him, and said she could see why Nate is thrilled.
Joanna said pets sure do make life better and was glad Max is bringing Nate lots of joy.
Nate said pets make people happier and never let them down, and asked Joanna whether she had thought any more about getting one of her own.
Joanna said on 20 May 2022 that allergies mean she does not really want a pet, and that she is too lazy to research alternative pets for her allergies.
Joanna said that writing and creative projects, along with her supportive friends, are what get her through tough times.
Joanna said it is priceless to have friends who understand and appreciate her work, because they can talk about it together and give her feedback.
Joanna shared a photo of a notepad with a dog on it and a pen, and said her third script is about loss, identity and connection, a story she had carried for ages before finding the guts to write it.
Nate asked whether Joanna's work was her third one, and Joanna confirmed the third screenplay has been a pretty wild journey that she is proud of.
Nate said Joanna really likes writing about sadness and loss, and Joanna said she had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics, but writes best when she is being true to herself.
Nate praised Joanna for staying strong, told her it takes guts to explore experiences and feelings, and said she has tons of talent and potential to reach for her dreams.
Nate said that the other day, before 25 May 2022, he took Max for a walk and met a super nice couple with a dog who live close by, and they decided to start doggy playdates.
Nate said the couple did not share much in common with him apart from a love of animals, which he thought was enough to make good friends.
Nate said meeting the couple felt like fate, that Max really likes the other dog, and that having a walking buddy for Max will be great.
Joanna said connecting with others who have pets can be uplifting and rewarding, and told Nate it is really cool that he can go out and meet people like that.
Nate said he really enjoys watching his pets play together, and that seeing Max so happy is like a dream come true.
Joanna said a peaceful presence around the home, or something to come home to, could help relieve stress and support relaxation.
Nate gave Joanna a stuffed animal puppy on 25 May 2022, sharing a photo of it on a bed, and said it is meant to remind her of good vibes.
Joanna said she loved the stuffed puppy from Nate and would cherish it with all her heart, and Nate said it is like having joy in your pocket that makes him grin.
Joanna said appreciating small joys like the stuffed animal is a nice reminder, and Nate said those little things make life better.
Joanna said she will always remember moments that bring happiness and remind her that life is great, and Nate said finding and cherishing little things is key, otherwise it is easy to get down.
Joanna said finishing her screenplay was tough, but the moments of joy along the way made the journey worth it, and Nate agreed the little moments matter most in tough times.
Joanna said appreciating the journey and being aware of happy moments keeps people focused on their dreams, and that she wants to show Nate her new work because she values his opinion.
Nate said on 25 May 2022 that he can't wait to see Joanna's work, is there to support her, and told her she has got this and to keep it up.
Joanna told Nate on 3 June 2022 that after finishing her screenplay she got a rejection letter from a major company, which really bummed her out.
Nate said rejection stinks but does not mean Joanna is not talented, and urged her not to give up on her dreams or on believing in herself.
Joanna said the major company sent only a generic rejection letter without much feedback, which was disheartening because she did not know why it did not work out.
Nate said the rejection is frustrating and told Joanna not to get discouraged and to just keep going.
Joanna said she would not let the rejection bring her down, thanked Nate for his support, and asked Nate what he had been up to lately.
Nate said he won another regional video game tournament in the week of 23 May 2022 and met new people there, which he found really cool.
Nate said winning was a huge confidence boost showing his hard work paid off, and that he is really happy with his progress as a gamer.
Joanna said it is great to hear about Nate's tournaments through the years, and Nate noted it has been a while since his first tournament.
Nate said some of the guys he talked to after the tournament wanted to hang out later, and shared a photo of a purple and blue controller with a star field design.
Joanna said it is good to have friends who share your interests, and Nate said the guys asked for tips to improve their game, so Nate offered to help.
Joanna praised Nate for helping strangers and stepping outside his comfort zone, and Nate said he just likes helping people.
Joanna said she was hiking with some buddies on the weekend of 4 to 5 June 2022, checking out a new trail with a rad waterfall.
Nate said on 3 June 2022 that he is organising a gaming party two weekends later, around 18 to 19 June 2022, which he expects to be hectic but fun.
When Joanna asked whether he would invite his tournament friends, Nate said definitely, along with old friends and teammates from other tournaments.
Nate said he is getting everyone custom controller decorations as a thank-you for coming to the gaming party, and Joanna said they would love the sweet idea.
Joanna wished Nate the best on the gaming party, and Nate asked Joanna to have a great hike and take lots of pics.
